title: Agent Manifest — Pipeline, Styles & APIs
description: Machine-readable index for AI agents to create music videos of any style in 1-2 fetches. See prompts.json for copy-paste genre prompts.
quick_start_for_agents: GET /api/docs/bootstrap — single call: returns manifest, codebase, API registry, MCP registry, and system info
GET /api/docs/search?q=<query> — full-text search across all docs with relevance scoring
GET /api/docs/structure — project directory tree for navigation
POST /api/audio/analyze with audio file → use beat_times + sections + energy_curve
Pick style from styles[genre] → use prompt_template + render preset → POST /api/video/generate-section → poll GET /api/jobs/{id}

ollama_integration.notes: Always use /api/chat endpoint for tool calling. Enable think:true for Gemma 4. Use flat tool arguments for best results.

pipeline.name: upload_and_analyze
pipeline.next: Pick style from styles[genre] based on user request

pipeline.name: configure_style
outputs: prompt ( <75 words, present tense, one paragraph)

render_presets.alt_3d: Hunyuan3D-2mini geometry ~5GB, then Blender EEVEE Next

pipeline.name: export_and_publish
tasks: export 16:9 1920x1080 + 9:16 1080x1920 safe 1620 (top 100/bottom 200) + 3-8s Canvas loop + thumbs x3 A/B
pipeline.youtube_algorithm: CTR (gateway 4-10%) -> Retention/Satisfaction Very High -> Session Time; Shorts decoupled (watch-through + replays)

happy.label: Happy / Upbeat
happy.prompt_template: Medium shot, eye-level angle, a joyful shrimp character dancing, underwater disco club, colorful neon lighting, energetic and fun, cinematic 35mm film
examples: A happy shrimp dancing in an underwater party, colorful coral reef, bright sunlight filtering through water, bubbles and confetti, joyful atmosphere, vibrant colors, cinematic 4k
Upbeat music festival, colorful lights, crowd silhouettes, neon confetti, energetic atmosphere, wide angle lens, golden hour lighting, 35mm film grain
happy.beat_mapping: high energy → wide shots, fast cuts on chorus, maximalist light clusters

calm.label: Calm / Chill
calm.prompt_template: Wide shot, bird's eye view, a cat studying at desk, cozy bedroom at night, warm lamp lighting, peaceful and relaxed, shallow depth of field
examples: Serene underwater scene, gentle currents, soft blue lighting, a shrimp floating peacefully, ethereal atmosphere, slow motion feel, shallow depth of field
Dreamy sunset over calm ocean, soft pastel colors, gentle waves, peaceful atmosphere, anamorphic lens flare, cinematic 24fps
calm.beat_mapping: low BPM → slow push, hold shots on sustained notes, desat bridge

dark.label: Dark / Moody
dark.prompt_template: Wide shot, low angle, a shrimp silhouette against deep blue abyss, single spotlight, cinematic noir lighting, dramatic shadows, 35mm film
examples: Dark moody underwater scene, a shrimp silhouette against deep blue abyss, single spotlight, cinematic noir lighting, dramatic shadows, 35mm film
Stormy ocean surface, dark clouds, lightning in background, dramatic atmosphere, high contrast, cinematic color grading, teal and orange palette
dark.beat_mapping: bridge → desaturated retro VHS, reduced motion, intimacy

electronic.label: Electronic / Synthwave
electronic.prompt_template: Close-up, low angle, a futuristic DJ performing, massage festival stage, laser lights, high energy and euphoric, synthwave 35mm film
examples: Cyberpunk underwater city, neon lights reflecting off futuristic buildings, a shrimp with cybernetic enhancements, synthwave color palette, pink and cyan lighting, digital art
Retro 80s music video aesthetic, neon grid floor, chrome surfaces, laser lights, a shrimp DJ performing, synthwave atmosphere, VHS tape grain
electronic.beat_mapping: neon pulse on every beat, camera orbit on chorus

natural.label: Natural / Organic
natural.prompt_template: Wide shot, eye-level angle, underwater garden, bioluminescent plants, a shrimp exploring coral formations, natural sunlight rays, warm golden tones, National Geographic style
examples: Underwater garden, bioluminescent plants, a shrimp exploring coral formations, natural sunlight rays, warm golden tones, National Garden photography style
Tropical ocean reef, vibrant coral ecosystem, a shrimp swimming among sea turtles, natural lighting, National Geographic documentary style, 4k detail
natural.beat_mapping: organic flow, tracking camera, natural palette shift via chroma

analyze.returns: AudioAnalysis {tempo_bpm, duration_seconds, beat_count, sections, beat_times, energy_curve, confidence, stored_path}

youtube.first_3s: most striking chorus moment, not slow intro
youtube.algorithm: Viewer Satisfaction Very High > CTR High > Avg View Duration High
